description: This file defines a React functional component named ProgressPanel that displays and manages progress statuses for skills associated with a specific role. It fetches role details, progress data, and allows updating skill statuses via API calls. The component relies on React hooks for state management and side effects, and it uses external API functions and utility functions.

methods.name: resolveRoleName
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches and resolves the role name based on the role ID.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads role details and progress data, updating component state accordingly.

methods.name: updateStatus
methods.description: Updates the progress status of a specific skill for the current role, optimistic UI update followed by API call.
